description: We're Team Naaah, students from Tashkent University of Information and Technologies (TUIT), who want to turn NASA Earth data into something you can actually hear and see for The Earth Information Jukebox. We're looking for curious people: coders, data fans, designers, and storytellers. You don't need to know everything, just bring energy and ideas. We split tasks clearly, check in often, and keep it friendly. Join us and let's build something useful!
